title: Mitosis core rebuild SPEC: rewrite from scratch

completion_criteria.text: A fresh audit of the current engine is recorded at a named base commit: phase and opts.phase census, verb surface, gate surface, and preconditions 0-5 status, each re-measured and none carried over.
Every binding decision 0106-0121 and every later record amending them is re-read from refs/heads/_ledger, its current force restated, and any superseded one named as superseded.
External research is done and cited with verifiable URLs or marked [unverified]: durable execution, gate and receipt models, and LSP-grounded dependency derivation.
The new SPEC is authored from the approved original's architecture with every claim grounded at a named anchor at the audit base; no text is lifted from the abandoned re-baselined documents.
The new SPEC carries its own verification contract: every citation re-runnable at its stated base, every count dated with the store it was read in, and one stated correction convention.
The new SPEC passes an independent gate, one fresh verifier per invariant inheriting no verdict, and stops at NOT READY rather than declaring a false green.
The user approves the rewritten SPEC and it is committed to a durable location, replacing the abandoned re-baselined documents as the spec of record.

Do not open the abandoned re-baselined SPEC or its docket for content — decision 0242 closed them, and lifting a passage risks importing a half-landed claim that eight rounds failed to clear
